YOUR NEXT HR CHALLENGE STARTS HERE

Do you know HR operations, and want to be a part of continuously optimizing our processes ?

We are looking for a People Services & Country Advisor to join our team in Kolding. You will combine hands-on HR expertise with knowledge of Danish employment legislation, and be working where local requirements, people and global HR processes meet.

People Services provides standardized services across the Vattenfall Group, and in this role, you will help ensure they work effectively in a Danish context.

What you will do

• Provide practical HR advice and guidance to employees, managers and HR colleagues

• Prepare contracts, amendments and other employment documentation

• Support payroll, time registration, pension and benefits processes

• Ensure high-quality employee data and work with SAP, SuccessFactors and ServiceNow

• Improve HR processes and identify opportunities for simplification, digitalization and automation

• Collaborate with colleagues across Denmark and our international People organization

• Develop and deliver relevant HR training to employees, managers and HR Business Partners

Qualifications

Is this you?

You have solid experience within HR Operations or a similar environment, together with good knowledge of Danish employment legislation. You enjoy solving problems, taking ownership, and turning complex HR questions into practical solutions.

You communicate confidently in Danish and English and are comfortable working across teams, functions and countries at all levels of the organization.

Experience with SAP, SuccessFactors or ServiceNow is an advantage.

An interest in, or experience using AI as a practical tool to simplify and improve HR processes would be a strong advantage.

Experience working with blue-collar employees and Danish trade unions is a preferred competence.

You will not be expected to know everything. But we do expect you to be curious enough to find out.

Most importantly, you bring drive, curiosity and the confidence to challenge how things are done and help us make them better.

Why join us?

You will join a team built on trust and honesty, where we speak up, challenge each other constructively, support one another, and, importantly, laugh a lot.

You will have real ownership, an international network and the opportunity to influence how HR services are developed in Denmark. The role also offers a hybrid working arrangement, with the possibility of working from home up to two days per week.

If you enjoy solving HR challenges, making complicated things simpler and shaping how People Services should work tomorrow, we would love to hear from you.

Additional Information

Location:

Kolding

At Vattenfall we are convinced that diversity contributes to build a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation.

Since Vattenfall is a part of critical infrastructure in multiple countries, many of our services are security classed.

If this position is security classified the final candidate might be subject to a security vetting/clearance process according to national legislation

How to apply

We welcome your application in English, including CV via the link, no later than the 13th of November 2026.

We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as applications will be reviewed and interviews conducted on an ongoing basis.

If you have questions regarding the position, you are welcome to contact Manager Vibeke Medum, People Services & Country Advisor DK, on vibeke.medum@vattenfall.com

We look forward to receiving your application!

Energy is our contribution to quality of life – day after day. With around 21,000 colleagues Vattenfall provides comprehensive electricity and heating offerings to several million customers in northern Europe. For the work ahead we need people who are fully dedicated to our customers and to a sustainable society – people like you.

Company Description

Vattenfall is a leading European energy company driving the transition to a sustainable energy system. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years. We employ around 21 000 people mostly in our core markets in Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK.

Business Area Wind is responsible for Vattenfall’s Onshore and Offshore Wind as well as other renewable activities such as solar PV and batteries. We develop, construct and operate wind generation and we have a clear strategy to develop our solar PV and battery operations further.

At Aalborg University, The Technical Faculty of IT and Design, Department of Architecture, Design and Media Technology (Copenhagen Campus) a full-time position as Postdoc is available for a period of 2 years from February 1, 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The Department of Architecture, Design, and Media Technology has as its goal the development of an innovative cluster of engineering-based environments for education and research which integrate creativity, engineering and technology within the disciplines of architecture, urban design, industrial design, lighting design, digital design and interactive media. The department is a leading research and educational environment in Denmark that addresses the challenge of the interplay between creativity and technology and develops new areas in research and education directed towards the end-user.

Your work tasks    The successful candidate will contribute to research, supervision, teaching, and semester coordination within Lighting Design at the Department of Architecture, Design and Media Technology, Aalborg University, Copenhagen.

Research activities will be conducted with the transdisciplinary Lighting Design Lab and will primarily contribute to externally funded research projects addressing societal challenges through lighting design, technology, and human-centric approaches.

Supervision responsibilities will primarily be associated with the MSc program in Lighting Design, which includes approximately 60 international students. Students work in project groups on semester-based lighting design projects and individually or in groups on master theses. The projects are grounded in a strong understanding of design-research processes and integrate theories, methods, and approaches across relevant academic disciplines. The position will also include coordination of semesters and related educational activities.

Teaching will primarily focus on the engineering and technical aspects of lighting design, particularly within courses such as Lighting Fundamentals and Evidence-Based Lighting Design. Topics include fundamental photometric and colorimetric concepts, lighting laws and principles, measurement quantities and methods, international standards, and objective methods for the measurement, observation, analysis, and evaluation of lighting conditions.

**Your competencies

**The successful candidate is expected to demonstrate the ability to identify emerging societal challenges and translate them into future competence and skill requirements for the lighting design profession. The candidate should also demonstrate an understanding of how these competences and skills can be integrated into teaching and research in lighting design at the highest academic level.

The candidate should demonstrate the ability to attract external research funding and to lead or contribute to interdisciplinary research projects involving multiple partners and stakeholders. Experience with innovation and cross-sector collaboration between academia, industry, and public-sector organizations is considered particularly relevant.

The candidate must have experience in relevant teaching and supervising diverse student groups, with a focus on developing an understanding of transdisciplinary design processes supported by relevant technical skills and a strong scientific foundation.

The candidate must demonstrate strong collaborative skills and the ability to work effectively as part of an international and interdisciplinary team of lighting designers, architects, engineers, and other researchers within the Lighting Design Lab in Copenhagen.

Who we are

The Lighting Design Lab brings together lighting designers, engineers, architects, and researchers who work collaboratively to advance teaching and research in lighting design. The Lab supports a two-year international MSc programme in Lighting Design and a strong transdisciplinary research environment.

Our work integrates architecture, engineering, AI, and media technology and is often conducted in collaboration with private-sector partners to address relevant societal challenges. Research and experimental activities combine contextual and architectural analysis of the light environment, including daylight and electric lighting, with consideration of human visual and non-visual needs and dynamic lighting conditions.

Design solutions are based on a perceived understanding of light environments supported by advanced technologies such as lighting control, sensing systems, sky scanners, and smartphone-based applications, while remaining grounded in human and societal needs. The Lab also maintains a strong international network and collaborates with leading universities and research environments within lighting design.

You may read more about the department here: https://www.create.aau.dk/om-create

Qualification requirements Appointment as postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

How to apply

Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position

• Curriculum Vitae (CV)

• Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma)

• List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications.

• Documentation of teaching qualifications if relevant.

• Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc.

• Additional qualifications in relation to the position

• References/recommendations

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. International staff are encouraged, with support from the university, to learn Danish during their employment in order to support their integration into the workplace and Danish society.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact associate professor Ellen Kathrine Hansen, ekh@create.aau.dk Phone: 0045 21723181

Further information

Read more about our recruitment process here

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Salary and terms of employment  The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Postdoc”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world

Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

About Userlink

Userlink runs AI agents in production at several hundred Nordic webshops, including Bahne, XL-BYG, Coolshop and Bygma. The agents handle the customer dialogue before and after the purchase, and every conversation ends up as structured data on demand and purchase barriers. The team is based in Odense.

The product and the direction

Today we sell chat. Email is rolling out now, and phone and social follow. On top of that we are building the brain: a system that brings together every signal about a webshop and its customers, understands why people buy, and why they do not, and acts on it while the buyer is still on the page. The effect is measured against a control group, so the shop can see what it means for revenue.

That moves the sale from a customer service tool to a conversation about growth, and revenue per customer can become several times what it is today.

The role

Ownership of the entire go-to-market in one place: lead generation, new business, partners and existing customers. You run the process from first contact to signature, find out what works and write the sales process the rest of the company will follow.

Lead generation is yours as a minimum. You own where the meetings come from: the customer profile, the lead lists and the sourcing of the right webshops, outbound and the campaigns that have to fill the pipeline. You measure what a meeting costs to acquire and which channels carry, and you shut down the ones that do not. You build it yourself at first and set direction for marketing and meeting booking as they come on board.

The partner channel has to be built. Agencies and platform partners need to be found, judged realistically and sold alongside until they can do it on their own.

Growth in the existing customer base is part of it, especially as email, phone and the brain roll out, measured against clear monthly and quarterly targets.

Price, pitch, customer profile and process are yours. They change when they do not work, and the team is built as the numbers allow. Denmark is home turf, but we already have customers and partners in DACH and the Netherlands, and those markets grow from here.

Decisions are made on arguments, not titles. Ideas get challenged regardless of where they come from, and the best one wins.

Why founding

You do not step into a finished sales organisation. You build the commercial side together with the founder, and what you decide on price, pitch, process and the first hires is what Userlink will sell on for years.

That is why the role comes with equity. You help build the company, and you own part of what you build. In return we expect you to take responsibility like a co-owner, also when things are unclear or go wrong.

Profile

• Has built sales in a B2B SaaS company as one of the first salespeople, with own meetings and own closes

• Has built lead generation from scratch, through outbound, partners or marketing, and knows what pipeline costs to acquire

• Has had a budget and hit it, and can explain in detail how

• Sells personally and teaches others to do it at the same time

• Experience selling outside Denmark, and a feel for what changes when you do

• Strong product and technology understanding, and uses AI every day in their own work

• Danish at native level, confident on calls, in meetings and in demos

• Fluent English is mandatory. English is the office language at Userlink

The person

• Dreams of owning and building a company

• Ideally has tried starting something and knows what it takes

• Thinks like a founder, not an employee

• Happily gives more than a regular job asks for, because it is fun

• Says things as they are, and can take the same in return

• Takes ownership and looks for solutions rather than excuses

• Curious, learns fast and has a positive mindset

What we offer

• Competitive salary plus uncapped commission

• Equity

• Short decision paths and close collaboration with product and engineering

• Office at Storms Pakhus in Odense, where we are every day

Application process

We take the time it takes to find the right match.

• Introductory conversation

• Conversation about expectations and terms

Write to jobs@userlink.ai about a SaaS product you helped scale, where the meetings came from, and what you personally did to make it happen.

jobs.occupation: Join Nykredit Markets as a Quantitative Developer (Analyst/Associate)
jobs.description:
_Would you like to help develop the next generation of quantitative models, tools, and AI solutions in Nykredit Markets? Do you thrive at the intersection of financial markets, technology, and innovation, and are you motivated by turning complex challenges into concrete solutions? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

_A key part of Nykredit Markets’ new strategy is a comprehensive upgrade of our quant platform and models. In Quantitative Solutions, we are responsible for this initiative and are currently developing Dragonfly — a modern, scalable, and highly optimized quant platform used for market making, pricing, and risk management of financial instruments across asset classes.

We are therefore looking for a Quantitative Developer who wants to work closely with the business and help develop and maintain solutions used daily by traders, sales professionals, and other specialists in Nykredit Markets.

**Your primary responsibilities:

**

• Design and development of analytics applications: Design, develop, and maintain Dragonfly applications and tools for pricing, risk management, and modeling of financial markets and instruments.

• Building scalable and robust quant infrastructure: Ensure that our quant platform and models run reliably and scale effectively, from infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines to monitoring and operations.

• Monitoring and optimizing production flows: Ensure robust processes, high data quality, and stable operation of our models and quant platform.

• Staying ahead with AI and new technology: Identify relevant AI use cases and help turn them into business solutions that create value in Markets and for our clients.

• Quantitative analysis and technical problem-solving: Work on complex financial and technological challenges and translate technical or quantitative analyses into concrete improvements and new opportunities.

**Are you the one we are looking for?

**We welcome applications from recent graduates, final-year Master’s students, and candidates with up to three years of relevant work experience. Depending on your qualifications and experience, the role will be at Analyst or Associate level.

We expect that you:

• hold a relevant university degree in finance, economics, IT, natural sciences, or engineering, with strong academic results,

• have strong software development and programming skills, including experience with Python and modern application development,

• have an interest in, and preferably experience with, AI or machine learning,

• are familiar with generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, RAG architectures, prompt engineering, or modern AI tools,

• understand software architecture, data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems,

• are analytically strong and motivated by solving complex financial and technical challenges,

• communicate effectively and collaborate well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders,

• have an interest in financial markets and quantitative analysis.

Experience with Microsoft Azure, Azure AI Foundry, cloud-native technologies, MLOps, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Django, React, or web development is an advantage, but not a requirement.

**Your new team

**You will join the QS Financial Engineering team, one of three teams in Quantitative Solutions. We are a department with a high level of professional expertise, where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous development are central to our day-to-day work. The department consists of desk quants, quant developers, and financial engineers. Together, we ensure that Nykredit Markets has the right models, applications, and analytical decision-support capabilities to remain in the strongest possible position in the market.

**About Nykredit Markets

**Nykredit Markets is part of the Nykredit Group, one of Denmark’s largest financial institutions. Nykredit Markets offers a broad range of financial services and products within capital markets, including trading in bonds, credit, FX, and equities. We serve both institutional and private investors with advisory services and tailored investment solutions.

**Want to know more?

**You are welcome to contactme, Sabina Mandsberg, Head of QS Financial Engineering, at quant@nykredit.dk if you have any questions about the position.

If you have questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our recruitment team at nytjob@nykredit.dk.

_We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and review applications as we receive them.

_We look forward to receiving your application and CV.

Senior Enterprise Account ExecutiveEnterprise Account Executive.

Copenhagen, on site.

Own the deal from first meeting to signature.

Focalx builds artificial intelligence that finds damage on vehicles in finished vehicle logistics, car rental and other use cases. Finished vehicle logistics is one of the largest supply chains in the world, and one of the least digitized. Most of it still runs on paper and manual damage checks.

Our customers are car makers, logistics providers, ports, rail operators and car rental fleets etc.

You build the pipeline and close it

This is not a role where a sales development team hands you leads and a script. You find the accounts, run the cycle and sign the contract.

You own enterprise deals from first outreach to signature. They are typically worth USD 100,000-500,000 in annual recurring revenue, and most start with a paid pilot that converts into a 6- or 7 digit USD deal.

You will work closely with our CEO, Morten Brøgger, and a technical pre-sales colleague, and you will on occasion travel to customers internationally. You own the budget, you close deals with everyone at Focalx contributing.

What you'll own:

Build your own pipeline

You contribute actively with insights and research defining our demand generation. We use all channels including outreach by all of us.

Run the full cycle

Discovery, business case, pilot, procurement, negotiation, signature. Before a pilot starts, you agree with the customer and our Customer Success what it has to prove. When the pilot ends, you use the positive ROI business case we build for the customer to close the contract.

Hold the buying committee

Our deals involve operations, finance, technology and procurement teams, often in several countries. You find the person who signs, know who can block the deal, and keep it moving when it stalls.

Bring the field back to us

What you hear from buyers shapes how we price, package and sell. You tell us early, with a proposal attached. You contribute to the product and our go to market strategies in every aspect.

Sell with the agents

Parts of our sales work already run on agents that research prospects, keep HubSpot clean and draft follow-ups. You use them every day and push them further. We are running a very efficient new school startup.

Your traits:

Enterprise closer. You have personally carried large, complex deals to signature and owned the outcome. Long cycles and slow procurement don't put you off.

Buying committee control. You reach the person who signs, keep a committee moving in one direction, and revive deals others had written off.

Credibility in the room. People who have spent 30 years in logistics, Rental or other vehicle verticals take you seriously. You are calm, factual, direct and hard to rattle in a negotiation.

This might come from enterprise software, industrial sales or logistics technology. You don't need automotive experience. You do need to have closed large enterprise deals yourself.

This probably isn't for you if you want a territory, a script and a steady flow of inbound leads. Or if you would rather manage sellers from behind a desk, than sell. Or if you think artificial intelligence in sales is overhyped, or you want to work remotely.

You might be someone who

• Was the person your company sent in when a deal mattered most.

• Got tired of being one account executive of forty, with a territory and a script.

• Closed a deal everyone else had given up on.

• Closed a game changing deal for your company

• Has wondered whether you could do what founders do, and wants to find out.

• Automates your own research and follow-up so you can spend the time with customers.

What good looks like in 12 months

• One or Two strategic deals closed.

• The pilots you sell convert, because what they had to prove was agreed before they started.

• Your pipeline is one you built, and your forecast is one we can plan cash on.

• Complex deals reach signature instead of stalling in procurement.

• Buyers treat Focalx as a serious partner from the first meeting.

Why join:

Own deals from day one • Negotiate at founder level • Enterprise customers, small team • Work directly with the founders • Shape how Focalx sells

How to apply:

Write directly to Morten Brøgger, our CEO, at morten@focalx.ai. Send your CV and a short note on:

• A complex deal you closed that others thought was dead.

• The toughest negotiation you've held your own in.

• Why Focalx, and why now.

SYBO is part of the Miniclip family and known for the widely popular game, Subway Surfers - the most downloaded mobile game in the world, with over four and a half billion downloads. Located in the heart of Copenhagen, we aim to create playful moments that inspire our fans to care.

We’re looking for a talented UI Artist to work with one of the biggest mobile games IP in the world: Subway Surfers.

Art has always been a northstar at SYBO, and we take great part in creating polished and high quality art that brings storytelling to life. Here you’ll join a seasoned group of artists all working closely together to make our games feel as good as it looks! We have a highly collaborative, feedback-friendly space where ideas bounce fast and bold, and where UI design really drives the player experience.

You’ll have the rare chance to shape UI at scale on either of our games, depending on which team you’ll be joining. If you’re the kind of artist who loves iterating, thrives on polish, and gets a kick out of elevating your team as much as your pixels - you’ll fit right in.

If above sounds interesting, and working with an IP that reaches hundreds of millions of players a month, read on!

**Responsibilities

**

• Create polished, lively UI art that enhances the established art direction and stays true to the Subway Surfers brand.

• Design intuitive and engaging UI screens, assets, and interactions for new and existing game features.

• Develop and present UI concepts and interactive prototypes that clearly communicate the intended look, feel, and player experience.

• Collaborate closely with the art, design and engineering to bring player-centric features from concept to implementation

• Contribute to UX work through wireframes, user flows and prototypes

• Create and maintain UI design systems, style guides, and documentation to support consistency and scalability across screens and features.

• Work directly with the Unity engine on pixel-perfect UI Implementation and asset performance optimization

Life at SYBO

In your first month, you’ll dive into our tools, pipelines, and the people behind them. You’ll get to know the direction of the game, the feel of the team, and slowly start contributing to UI work and discussions.

Within 3 months, you’re now owning key UI assignments. You collaborate closely with game design, and your work is directly shaping and refining the player journey.

By 12 months, you’ve become a core part of the team’s creative engine - raising the bar for UI art and design, pushing for polish, and helping define what great looks like at SYBO. Maybe even beyond your own game team.

**Requirements

**

• A strong portfolio demonstrating solid UI work for games, with clear examples of creating intuitive, polished, and engaging UIs.

• Ability to follow - and build on - an established art direction

• Some experience creating wireframes, user flows and mockups - we don’t expect you to be a UX expert, but we expect you to be the UI expert, and have a solid grasp of how that fits into UX.

• Skilled at designing, rendering - and possibly animating - high-quality UI elements that bring personality and clarity to the player experience.

• Proficiency with modern UI/UX and prototyping tools, particularly Figma.

• Experience working with Unity or similar engines, and a solid understanding of UI implementation

Bonus Points

• Experience working on large-scale live service mobile games.

**About SYBO

**We're SYBO, the mobile games studio behind the legendary Subway Surfers, with over 4 billion downloads worldwide! Join our team in the heart of Copenhagen, where creativity flourishes in our new, state-of-the-art studio.

If you join us, you'll have the opportunity to dive into exciting and creative projects alongside a diverse group of like-minded colleagues from over 40 countries across the globe.

We truly believe you perform your best, when you have the equipment you need - and our IT team is always on hand to ensure you have access to the latest tools and gear, enabling you to be at your best - even remotely with a home-office budget!

We also pride ourselves in taking care of your well-being, offering a delicious lunch buffet, a variety of healthy snacks, and regular social events to keep the energy flowing.

Not in Copenhagen? Not a problem! We have in-house relocation specialists who will help you relocate, and feel right at home in Copenhagen and at SYBO!

SYBO is committed to providing equal opportunities to all applicants, regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

The Opportunity

Veo’s web platform brings together some of our most important customer experiences. We are looking for a Staff Experience Designer with deep Web expertise to own design outcomes for our Core Web Experience and help raise its quality across the teams that contribute to it.

This is a hands-on, AI-first individual-contributor role. You will lead complex cross-team design work, bring a strong point of view, and support other designers with feedback, frameworks, and shared patterns.

You will partner with Stakeholders, Product Managers, and Engineers to connect customer needs, business goals, and technical realities, align teams, and carry ideas through to high-quality outcomes.

**What You Will Do

**

• Lead the end-to-end design of complex Core Web initiatives involving multiple teams, owning outcomes from problem framing through implementation.

• Work hands-on across problem framing, research, interaction design, prototyping, visual design, validation, and implementation.

• Use AI throughout the design process to expand exploration, accelerate learning, and make ideas tangible faster.

• Partner with stakeholders across teams to bring customer insight, data, business goals, and technical trade-offs into decisions and alignment.

• Identify gaps in customer journeys and shared web patterns, then work with the relevant teams to make practical improvements.

• Create frameworks, prototypes, and reusable guidance, and provide constructive feedback that helps other designers and teams deliver high-quality work.

**What You Could Bring

**

• 10+ years of experience in product design with a strong track record of designing and shipping sophisticated web products and leading complex work involving multiple teams.

• Deep expertise in responsive design, interaction patterns, information architecture, accessibility, and visual craft.

• Demonstrated experience using AI tools in real design work, with the curiosity to continually explore new capabilities and practices.

• Strong product judgment, connecting customer needs, business goals, data, and technical constraints while navigating ambiguity.

• A systems mindset, including experience evolving design systems, shared patterns, and fragmented experiences.

• Strong communication, facilitation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence decisions and help peers improve their work.

Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger

outcomes.

Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally)

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to make meaningful contributions.

Are you passionate about contemporary design and bringing innovative lighting products to life?

• Do you have a technical background and experience developing products from concept to production?

• Would you like to join a creative and international team in the heart of Copenhagen?

If yes, please read on!

PRODUCT DEVELOPER – LIGHTING

Based in Copenhagen

At our office in the heart of Copenhagen, you will join our Lighting Product Development team, working closely with talented designers, colleagues across different functions and international manufacturing partners. You will play a key role in transforming creative ideas into high-quality lighting products that combine design, functionality and technical excellence.

About the job

As Product Developer – Lighting at HAY, you will be involved in developing decorative LED lighting products from initial concept to final production. Combining technical development skills with a strong understanding of design, you will work closely with designers, internal teams and international manufacturing partners to bring creative ideas to life.

An important part of your role will be to maintain the original design intent throughout the development process, while ensuring that products meet technical requirements and can be manufactured efficiently. You will help drive projects forward, balancing design, functionality, quality, cost and timelines.

Your daily tasks will include:

• Manage product development projects from initial concept to production, ensuring timelines and key deliverables are met.

• Develop decorative LED lighting solutions, including optics, thermal management, drivers and dimming technologies.

• Create detailed, production-ready 3D models, assemblies and technical drawings using SolidWorks.

• Translate design concepts into technically feasible products, developing and testing prototypes and resolving technical and manufacturing challenges.

• Prepare technical specifications, bills of materials (BOMs) and test documentation.

• Ensure compliance with relevant electrical, safety, sustainability and regulatory requirements.

• Collaborate with designers, internal teams and external manufacturing partners throughout the development process.

• Manage project timelines, costs and technical deliverables, supporting suppliers with tooling, pilot production and quality control.

• Format 2D documentation utilizing Microsoft and Adobe Creative Suite packages.

Are you the Product Developer we are looking for?

We are looking for a technically skilled Product Developer who is passionate about contemporary design and has an eye for detail. You understand how to translate creative ideas into functional products without compromising the designer's original vision. You combine technical knowledge with a practical, solution-oriented approach and enjoy working at the intersection of design, engineering and manufacturing. You are comfortable taking responsibility for your projects, keeping track of timelines and collaborating with colleagues and external partners to find the best solutions.

Role expectations

• You are structured and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.

• You enjoy collaborating with designers, colleagues and external partners.

• You are a team player who values collaboration and contributes positively to the HAY culture.

Experience required

• You have a relevant educational background in Product Development, Industrial Design, Engineering or a related field.

• You have experience in technical product development, ideally taking products from concept to production. Experience within decorative lighting is an advantage.

• You have technical knowledge of LED lighting and an understanding of relevant electrical, safety and regulatory requirements.

• You are proficient in SolidWorks, including 3D modeling, assemblies and technical drawings.

• You have experience with prototyping, testing and technical documentation, along with an understanding of materials, manufacturing processes and supplier collaboration.

• You are familiar with Microsoft Office and Adobe Creative Suite for preparing and formatting product documentation.

• You communicate confidently in English, both written and spoken, as we are an international company.

You want to be a part of HAY?

Then do not hesitate to send us your application and CV, along with a portfolio showcasing relevant product development projects, as soon as possible and no later than Wednesday 18 November. We evaluate candidates on an ongoing basis.

If you have any further questions regarding the position, please do not hesitate to contact Recruiter, John Cain at john_cain@hermanmiller.com or Senior Manager, Sam Weller at sam.weller@hay.com.

Why join us?

Founded in Copenhagen in 2002 with the ambition of creating contemporary furniture, lighting and accessories for modern living, HAY’s vision is to create high-quality and well-designed products in collaboration with some of the world’s most talented, curious, and courageous designers. Through the commitment to sophisticated industrial manufacturing processes, HAY strives to make good design accessible to the widest possible audience.

atNorth is a leading Nordic data center company providing cost-effective, scalable high-density colocation and built-to-suit services to industry-leading organizations across Iceland, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark.

With sustainability at our core, our data centers run on renewable energy and are designed according to circular economy principles. Through innovative design, power efficiency, and intelligent operations, we deliver reliable, secure, and high-performance infrastructure.

Headquartered in Reykjavik, Iceland, atNorth operates eight data centers across the Nordics, with additional sites under development in Finland, Denmark, and Sweden.

We combine world-class technology with a people-first culture built on collaboration, ownership, and trust, empowering our teams to grow, take responsibility, and make a real impact.

By joining our international team, you will help shape the future of sustainable digital infrastructure.

**Project Scheduler at atNorth

**Are you a master of project controls who thrives on turning complex infrastructure dependencies into highly predictable, synchronized execution plans? As a Project Scheduler at atNorth, you will ensure accurate planning, coordination, and tracking of all activities across the entire data center construction lifecycle. You will act as the critical link connecting our engineering, procurement, and construction teams, ensuring that every milestone from initial design to final commissioning stays firmly on track.

This is a high-impact position within our PMO structure where your analytical insights, critical path analyses, and proactive risk-mapping will directly drive predictable, on-time project delivery across our rapidly expanding Nordic footprint.

**Key responsibilities:

**

• Develop, baseline, and maintain fully integrated master schedules for our data center projects, meticulously covering design, permitting, civil works, MEP installation, commissioning, and final handover.

• Ensure procurement timelines for long-lead items (LLI) and owner-furnished, contractor-installed (OFCI) equipment are seamlessly integrated into the active construction schedules.

• Monitor schedule performance using Earned Value Management (EVM) and progress metrics. Identify deviations, track float, and proactively flag critical path risks and delay mitigation opportunities to Project Managers and senior stakeholders.

• Rigorously review and challenge external contractor schedules for logic, realism, and contractual compliance, highlighting gaps or inconsistencies before they impact the site.

• Support weekly and monthly programme reviews by preparing updated schedules, dashboards, look-aheads, and scenario/what-if analyses. Partner with Cost Management to align schedule tracking with cash flow forecasting.

• Refine planning standards, templates, and scheduling methodologies in coordination with the PMO to increase delivery efficiency portfolio-wide.

**Your profile:

**

• A technical degree in Construction Management, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field

• 5+ years of dedicated project controls, scheduling, or planning experience, with a distinct preference for professionals coming out of the data center sector or complex, mission-critical infrastructure environments.

• Advanced, hands-on proficiency in industry-standard planning tools, specifically Primavera P6 and MS Project.

• Deep understanding of data center design and construction workflows, scheduling logic, interdependencies, and Earned Value Management methodology.

• Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge external contractors and translate complex timeline risks into clear, actionable advice for internal project teams.

• Holding a PMP or Prince2 certification is considered a strong advantage.

• Fluency in written and spoken English is required; proficiency in any local Nordic language is a plus.

**About the atNorth Culture

**We believe that sustainable success starts with the wellbeing of our people. For us, an open, transparent, and inclusive culture is more than a priority, it is the core of how we lead and innovate.

We don’t just talk about culture; we nurture it. Through regular one-to-one engagements and monthly wellbeing surveys, we listen carefully to our teams, ensuring that every voice is heard and every opportunity for improvement is embraced.

We recognize that innovation and collaboration thrive where people feel truly connected, which is why we come together each week to share ideas, strengthen relationships, and nurture a sense of belonging, sometimes over a simple breakfast and good conversation.

At atNorth, we are building a community where you can do your best work and shape a sustainable future together. #99

jobs.occupation: Technical Lead - Substation Automation and Communication Systems
jobs.description:
Do you have experience with automation and communication systems for high-voltage substations? Can you lead technical work packages and coordinate specialist contributions to deliver an integrated solution? Join COWI as our new Technical Lead and contribute to the development of Denmark’s electricity transmission infrastructure.

Take technical responsibility for substation automation projects

We are looking for an experienced engineer to take technical responsibility for substation automation and communication systems in high-voltage substation projects. You will work on projects ranging from new substations to extensions, refurbishment and replacement of systems at existing sites. You will coordinate specialist contributions, manage technical interfaces and ensure that individual work packages meet the requirements of the overall substation automation solution.

The role combines technical expertise with responsibility for coordinating engineering activities, monitoring progress and ensuring the quality of technical deliverables. You will work closely with the project manager, technical specialists and other engineering disciplines throughout project execution.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Lead and coordinate the technical delivery of substation automation and communication systems.

• Plan and follow up on engineering activities, technical deliverables and milestones within your scope.

• Coordinate specialist contributions and ensure consistency across technical work packages.

• Ensure that technical solutions and documentation comply with project requirements, customer specifications and applicable standards.

• Manage technical interfaces between automation, communication systems, protection systems, primary equipment and auxiliary systems.

• Identify and resolve technical issues in collaboration with specialists and other engineering disciplines.

• Participate in project meetings and advise the project manager on technical matters, dependencies and risks within your area of responsibility.

• Coordinate technical activities with customers, suppliers and other project stakeholders.

Your expertise

You combine a strong technical foundation with a structured approach to planning and coordination. You can assess how individual systems and specialist contributions fit together, communicate technical requirements clearly and follow through on agreed actions.

You work independently and build effective working relationships with colleagues, customers and project partners.

You will also bring:

• A degree in electrical engineering or an equivalent technical qualification, together with more than five years of relevant experience in automation for high-voltage substations.

• A solid understanding of substation automation systems, including control and monitoring functions, communication networks and interfaces to protection equipment.

• An understanding of how substation secondary systems interface with high-voltage primary equipment.

• Experience coordinating technical work packages, planning engineering activities and following up on specialist deliverables.

• The ability to assess technical solutions, manage interfaces and maintain an overview of quality, progress and dependencies.

• Professional proficiency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

• The ability to obtain the required security clearance and fulfil the requirements for the designated on-site role of “holdleder” at high-voltage substations.

Your place of work

Depending on project requirements, you may work from one of COWI’s offices in Denmark, at Energinet project locations or partly from home. Travel within Denmark is expected.

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Got more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Head of Discipline Carsten Sass Husum at CSHU@COWI.COM.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

Equal opportunity employer

COWI provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, COWI complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Shape the Future of Privacy

**Usercentrics is a global leader in data privacy and privacy-led marketing solutions. We believe there is no need for a trade-off between growth and privacy compliance. Our vision is to unlock the potential of data privacy to empower a thriving digital ecosystem. We work with companies to create a healthy balance between data-driven business and privacy-led marketing for every size of enterprise. Our customers build trust with their users through improved transparency and control to drastically improve marketing and monetization, while achieving full privacy compliance.

**About the Role

**Revenue Operations is the horizontal backbone behind Usercentrics' three go-to-market motions — Self Serve, Sales Led, and Partner Led. As we scale, our Salesforce ecosystem and wider GTM tech stack need a single owner who can turn ambitious business requirements into governed, scalable systems. As Manager, GTM Systems & Innovation, you'll lead a team spanning Salesforce administration and GTM engineering, and you'll be the one deciding how AI-native automation gets built into our GTM workflows. You'll partner closely with other Revenue Operations teams, the broader GTM organization, and stakeholders across Finance and Product to translate business requirements into efficient, reliable systems.

**Responsibilities

**> Own CRM architecture and governance end-to-end, ensuring Salesforce supports Self Serve, Sales Led, and Partner Led without compromising on data integrity.

> Set the roadmap and standards for the wider GTM tech stack, tying every major investment to a clear business outcome - pipeline quality, forecasting reliability, or support efficiency - not just tool delivery.

> Lead and grow a small team spanning Salesforce administration, Salesforce architecture, and GTM engineering, keeping the team focused on high-impact initiatives tied to clear business outcomes, and acting as the final technical decision-maker on system changes.

> Drive AI-native workflows and automation across GTM - from propensity and churn scoring models to workflow automation - that reduce manual work, increase seller and CS productivity, and improve the customer experience.

> Own attribution and data hygiene practices, partnering closely with BI on the underlying data infrastructure and pipeline.

> Drive adoption and value realization of the systems you build, partnering with GTM Enablement to make sure new capabilities actually change day-to-day behavior, not just go live.

> Continuously evaluate GTM tooling and market trends, bringing investment recommendations to the VP of Revenue Operations based on expected business impact and ROI.

**Requirements

**

**Experience

**> 5+ years of experience in RevOps, Salesforce administration and GTM systems, with real ownership of architecture-level decisions.

> Experience managing a technical team in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.

**Technical Skills

**> Deep, hands-on Salesforce expertise (architecture, automation, integrations).

> Practical experience with tools like n8n, Clay, and Outreach, and with AI-assisted workflows in a revenue context.

**Operating Skills

**> Strong data instincts: comfortable owning attribution, data hygiene, and governance across a growing tech stack.

> Confident operating independently and making system decisions without needing to escalate every call.

> Comfortable being the technical backstop for a Solution Architect, Administrator, and Engineer, without needing to do the hands-on build yourself day to day.

**Benefits

**

Include:

> Development Budget for every employee: 800,- EUR / year

> Job-related Language Courses (English, German, Czech, Spanish etc.): 350,- EUR / year

> Hybrid working policy and the possibility to take a workcation (90 days per year from a European country

> Online yoga sessions

> Massages

> Headspace App

> Events - Team Buildings, happy hours, parties/get togethers, occasional company covered breakfasts/lunches, in/across offices, online/in person etc

> Gifts - We celebrate life & work milestones at UC (work anniversaries, new born babies and similar)

> Snacks, fruits, coffee and drinks in the office

Joining Usercentrics means becoming part of a fast-growing, diverse and international team of tech enthusiasts and entrepreneurially-minded who build our success story together

Company culture is important to us - we strive to continuously develop a positive, vibrant and inspiring environment that enables everyone to thrive both personally and professionally

Get involved! We have plenty of initiatives and love to see people from all department enthusiastically participating and shaping our future together in different cross-department projects

Your work-life balance is important to us too - we offer flexible working hours, hybrid working and the possibility of workcations (in accordance with our company policy)

We always remember to have fun along the way, both in our day-to-day work and at our regular team events on site in our offices in Munich, Copenhagen, Odense, Lisbon, New York and Buenos Aires or online

You are the most valuable asset to our company which is why we're happy to offer awesome benefits like our personal development budget, job-related language courses and a lot more (depending on your location) to focus on your well being

Usercentrics is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Lead our global spare parts and purchasing operations

Based at our R&D and sales facilities in Hadsten, Denmark, you are going to work closely with colleagues across our sites, leading operations with responsibility for commercial performance, purchasing strategy and operational excellence.

Your key responsibilities

You will bring together business development, strategic sourcing and operational management to build a profitable, responsive and scalable operation. Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Revenue Growth & Business Development: Take ownership of the global spare parts business and its P&L, identifying opportunities to grow aftermarket sales, improve margins and increase profitability.

• 
Strategic Sourcing & Purchasing: Lead sourcing and supplier management for critical mechanical and electronic components. Negotiate competitive pricing and reliable lead times while building strong, long-term supplier relationships.

• 
Fast & Transparent Order Fulfilment: Improve order turnaround times by streamlining and automating processes from order entry to dispatch. Remove manual bottlenecks and increase delivery visibility and tracking transparency for customers.

• 
Multi-Site Operations: Provide unified leadership across our operations, working closely with warehousing, engineering and other colleagues in Hadsten, Rønne and Urk to align priorities.

• 
Customer Satisfaction & Service Performance: Establish ways to measure and track customer satisfaction with spare parts availability, delivery and fulfilment. Use performance data and customer feedback to identify and strengthen service levels.

• 
ERP & Inventory Optimization: Drive effective use of Uniconta to improve inventory accuracy, automate replenishment planning and strengthen purchasing, stock control and financial reporting.

• 
Financial Planning & Performance Management: Work closely with the CFO on budgeting, forecasting, lifecycle cost management and operational KPIs, using data to guide decisions and deliver measurable improvements.

Your qualifications

You are a commercially minded and structured leader who combines strategic thinking with a hands-on approach to improving operations. You understand how purchasing, inventory, supplier performance and customer service work together to drive business results. We imagine you bring:

• Leadership Experience: A strong track record in senior management within spare parts, aftermarket, strategic purchasing or supply chain operations.

• Strategic Purchasing Expertise: Proven experience in sourcing technical components, negotiating supplier agreements and managing supplier relationships in an industrial environment.

• Digital & Analytical Skills: Experience with ERP systems and process automation, along with the ability to use data and KPIs to improve performance. Knowledge of Uniconta is an advantage.

• Cross-Functional Leadership: The ability to bring together purchasing, engineering, warehousing, finance and commercial teams around shared goals.

• Education & Communication: A relevant degree in Supply Chain Management, Purchasing, Business Administration, Engineering or a related field. Fluent English is essential; Danish, Dutch or other European languages are an advantage.

What you can look forward to

As our new Head of Global Spare Parts and Strategic Purchasing, you will have the opportunity to shape a business area with a direct impact on Borncut’s commercial performance, customer relationships and international growth. You can look forward to:

• High-impact leadership: Taking ownership of the development and profitability of our global spare parts business while shaping our purchasing strategy.

• International collaboration: Working with teams and leaders across European locations and collaborating closely with the leadership of Borncut.

• An Innovation-Driven Culture: Joining an international, supportive environment built on continuous innovation, integrity, unity and extreme customer focus.

Some projects may be subject to specific security requirements, and the ability to obtain relevant security clearance may be required.

**Do you have more questions?

**If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Senior Talent Acuisition Specialist, Mette Gutte at mtgt@cowi.com. Get to know our work with data centre projects even better here: Can you make tomorrow’s digital infrastructure feel at home?

**A place to work and so much more

**At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home. With offices primarily located in Scandinavia, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

**Before you apply

**All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so the role may close as soon as we find the right match.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key

**We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.
